mapper.select: SELECT team_code, team_name, sort_order, use_yn, created_at, updated_at FROM team ORDER BY use_yn DESC, sort_order, team_code
SELECT team_code, team_name, sort_order, use_yn, created_at, updated_at FROM team WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_order, team_code
